|-|Guide=
*'''All the Gold in Chinatown''' The additional loot in the heist are:
**a tea set which is found in a safe in the back office of the auction room.
**6 artifacts (2 of which are paintings). In the room next to the auction room, there are 2 normal artifacts and 2 paintings. It is advised to bag all 4 artifacts in this room before turning on the lights as everyone will flood into the room. The last 2 artifacts are in the tea shop itself, both inside glass cases which need to be lockpicked.
**4 bags of gold are found in the vault room.
**3 bags of coke in shipping containers. 2 coke containers are found in the warehouse and the last one is in the room between the warehouse and auction room.
|-|Trivia=
*'''For The Mad Hatter''' is a reference to {{w|Hatter (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland)|The Mad Hatter}} from {{w|Lewis Carroll}}'s 1865 book {{w|Alice's Adventures in Wonderland}}, who is frozen in time forever stuck at 6pm in an endless tea party. The Hatter tried to sing to the foul-tempered {{w|Queen of Hearts (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland)|Queen of Hearts}} who sentenced him to death by decapitation. Father Time retaliated and froze The Mad Hatter in time out of respect for him. The "Laohu Dashi" outfit is a reference to {{w|Bruce Lee}} and his yellow jumpsuit. The name translates to "Tiger Master", referencing the black and yellow colors of the outfit.
